benefit.badge.title: Official shop badge
benefit.badge.text: Separate from the Certified seller badge, on your page and all your listings.
benefit.visibility.title: More visibility
benefit.visibility.text: Listed in the shop directory and on the home page.
benefit.aisles.title: Custom aisles
benefit.aisles.text: Organise your items into aisles on your page.
benefit.featured.title: Featured items
benefit.featured.text: Pin your best items to the top of your shopfront.
benefit.stock.title: Stock management
benefit.stock.text: Several units per listing, deducted with each completed sale.
benefit.stats.title: Shop statistics
benefit.stats.text: Visits to your page, new followers, most viewed items.
plan.title: Official shop subscription
plan.paid: Subscription active: {{n}} free credits added to your wallet.
doc.rccmHint: Trade and Personal Property Credit Register (e.g. {{example}}).
doc.taxHint: {{label}}, as shown on your tax certificate.
doc.importHint: PDF, JPG or PNG — 12 MB maximum. The whole document, readable.
wizard.identityText: What buyers will see on your official shopfront.
wizard.contactsText: Your point of sale’s contact details, shown on your page.
wizard.docText: Your company’s registration proof, checked by the Dilchap team.
summary.title: Your application summary
summary.nothingNow: Nothing to pay now: the subscription is paid once the shop is approved.
summary.consent: I solemnly certify that the information and document provided are genuine, and that I am authorised to represent this company on Dilchap.
offer.title: Open my Official shop
offer.text: For registered companies and brands: a shopfront in your name, verified by Dilchap.
offer.notVerified: Not verified — to do before applying
offer.companyDocText: RCCM extract or {{taxId}} certificate, to upload during the application (PDF or photo).
offer.verifyFirst: Verify your identity first: the shop is linked to a verified manager.
pending.title: Application under review
pending.text: Your application has been sent. The Dilchap team is checking your legal document and your shop details.
pending.step1.title: Application received
pending.step2.title: Verification
pending.step2.text: Check of the registration document and trade name.
pending.step3.title: Shopfront activation
pending.step3.text: Once approved, pay the subscription to display the badge.
pending.noAction: Nothing to do: you’ll get a notification as soon as a decision is made.
rejected.title: Application to correct
rejected.text: Some parts of your application need updating before your Official shop can be approved.
rejected.reason: Reason given by the verification team
rejected.tip1: Upload the complete document (all relevant pages), sharp and without glare.
rejected.tip2: Copy the number exactly as it appears on the document.
rejected.tip3: The trade name must match the registered company’s name.
suspended.title: Your shop is suspended
suspended.text: It no longer appears in the directory or on the home page. You can still manage your listings from “My listings”.
activate.title: Official shop approved
activate.lapsedText: Your subscription ended on {{date}}. Renew it to get back the badge and your place in the directory.
activate.text: Congratulations, your company has been verified. Activate the subscription to put your shopfront online.
activate.perk.pageText: Shop page, aisles and featured items.
activate.perk.badgeText: On your page and all your listings.
activate.perk.creditsText: In your wallet, to use on your listings.
activate.note: Paid in credits. No commitment: no automatic renewal.
manager.text: Organise your aisles, featured items and stock.
manager.noAutoRenew: No automatic renewal: extend by {{days}} days whenever you like.
stock.title: Inventory & stock
stock.text: Each completed sale removes the units sold; the listing becomes “Sold” at zero.
aisles.text: The tabs of your shop page. Assign an aisle to each item from the Stock tab.
aisles.empty: No aisles: all your items are shown together.
aisles.deleteText: Its items stay online, just without an aisle.
featured.text: Shown at the very top of your page ({{n}} of {{max}} pinned).
featured.empty: Post listings to be able to pin them.
profile.title: Shopfront
profile.text: Trade name and {{type}} number verified: to change them, contact the Dilchap team.
profile.name: Trade name

qr.title: Your QR codes
qr.text: Print and stick them on your shop window, bags or cards: one scan opens your shop directly. Print at 100% (without “fit to page”).
